summary: Rentable L-4 lookout above the Malheur National Forest, built as an emergency post in 1930 and standing in its current 1933/1953 form today.

facts.design: L-4 ground cab on an 18-foot pole tower
facts.status_note: Cab largely original; the pole tower beneath it was replaced in 1953.

access.note: Reachable by vehicle; rented overnight through Recreation.gov. The final stretch of road is narrow, rutted and rough, and Recreation.gov recommends a high-clearance vehicle -- a rougher account than a 2007 renter's 'no ruts in road.' A telecom site is adjacent, with excellent cell reception but towers and generator noise intruding on the sunrise view from the catwalk.

visit.trail_note: Wilderness trailheads roughly 30 minutes away by vehicle; multi-use trailhead at Starr Springs south of the tower.

facts.agency: U.S. Forest Service, Malheur National Forest, Blue Mountain Ranger District

events.note: Established as an emergency fire lookout.
National Historic Lookout Register dates construction of the 18-foot pole tower and L-4 cab to 1933, rather than 1930.
The pole tower was replaced; the L-4 cab remained largely original.
Registered March 8, 1995 as NHLR US 115 / OR 15, nominated by Gary McAtee and Ron Johnson of the Oregon FFLA chapter.
Renter visit report (Sept 3, 2007): fridge, new stove/oven, futon, clean outhouse; needed exterior paint; nearby cell towers and generator noise intrude on the view.

notes_for_editor: The tower record's build-year conflict (1930 vs 1933) resolves fairly well once the NHLR page is read in full: it describes an emergency post dating to around 1930/1933 with the cab original but the tower rebuilt in 1953 — a detail not yet in the tower JSON's events. No newspaper or Forest Service administrative-history source was found in the cache or a quick web check; everything here comes from the three register/rental pages already linked on the record. Did not propose a correction since the conflict is explainable rather than contradictory, but an editor may want to add the 1953 tower-rebuild event to the main tower record.
